sn46.28:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the path that partakes of penetration.
sn46.28:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path that partakes of penetration?
sn46.28:1.7: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.”
sn46.28:1.8: When this was said, the Venerable Udayī asked the Blessed One:
sn46.28:1.9: “Venerable sir, how are the seven factors of enlightenment developed and cultivated so that they lead to penetration?”
sn46.28:2.1: “Here, Udayī, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release; which is vast, exalted, measureless, without ill will.
sn46.28:2.2: With a mind that has developed the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, he penetrates and sunders the mass of greed that he has never before penetrated and sundered;
sn46.28:2.3: he penetrates and sunders the mass of hatred that he has never before penetrated and sundered;
sn46.28:2.4: he penetrates and sunders the mass of delusion that he has never before penetrated and sundered….
sn46.28:2.5: “He develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release; which is vast, exalted, measureless, without ill will.
sn46.28:2.6: With a mind that has developed the enlightenment factor of equanimity, he penetrates and sunders the mass of greed …
sn46.28:2.8: the mass of delusion that he has never before penetrated and sundered.
sn46.28:2.9: “It is, Udayī, when the seven factors of enlightenment are developed and cultivated in this way that they lead to penetration.”
